### Python Example
The following Python code creates a small dataset and displays a summary.

```{python}
import pandas as pd

data = {
    "Career": ["Data Scientist", "Data Analyst", "Data Engineer"],
    "Job_Count": [120, 95, 80]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

df
```
